pending_supervisor.how_to_decide: To decide, use the supervisor tools: node_retry (re-run node `boom`), run_continue_from (advance from a chosen node), or run_abort.
pending_supervisor.instruction: The supervised run is waiting for a supervisor decision after node `boom` failed. Available options: retry, continue_from, abort. To decide, use the supervisor tools: node_retry (re-run node `boom`), run_continue_from (advance from a chosen node), or run_abort.
